verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੪ : ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 24 : guroo naanak dhev jee dhaa pratham prasa(n)g

en.bdb: First episode of Guru Nanak Dev ji

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਬਾਬੇ ਪਾਯਾ ਬਖਸੁ ਦਰਿ ਪਿਛੋਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਾਲਿ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pahilaa baabe paayaa bakhas dhar pichhodhe fir ghaal kamaiee|

en.bdb: First of all Baba Nanak obtained the gate of the grace (of Lord) and then He underwent and earned the rigorous discipline (of heart and mind).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੇਤੁ ਅੱਕੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋੜਾ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਅ ਵਿਛਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ret a'k aahaar kar roRaa kee gur keea vichhaiee|

en.bdb: He fed himself with sand and swallow-wort and made stones his bedding i.e. he enjoyed poverty too.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਰੀ ਕਰੀ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaaree karee tapasiaa vadde bhaag har siau ban aaiee|

en.bdb: He offered his full devotion and then he was fortunate to have proximity with God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਸਚਿ ਖੰਡਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabaa paidhaa sach kha(n)dd nau nidh naam gareebee paiee|

en.bdb: Baba reached the region of truth wherefrom he received Naam, the storehouse of nine treasures and  humility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਜਲਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabaa dhekhai dhiaan dhar jalatee sabh pirathavee dhis aaiee|

en.bdb: In his meditation, Baba found the whole earth burning (with the fire of lust and anger).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੈ ਹੈ ਕਰਦੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baajh guroo gubaar hai hai hai karadhee sunee lukaiee|

en.bdb: Without Guru there is utter darkness and he heard the cries of the common men.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੇ ਭੇਖ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਚਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabe bhekh banaiaa udhaasee kee reet chalaiee|

en.bdb: To further understand the people, Guru Nanak donned robes in their manner and preached them to be detached (from the pleasure and pain).
Thus he went out to depurate humanity on earth.
